description: Use this when the user asks about a specific Model Context Protocol server — whether it is listed in the official MCP registry, what endpoint it publishes, how current its listing is, or whether that endpoint responds. Returns the registry record (name, version, publish and update dates, declared remote endpoints, registry status) plus the result of one anonymous request to a registry-published endpoint. Reports observations only. It does NOT assess whether a server is safe, trustworthy, well-built or suitable — we cannot see what a server does with data, and reachability is not safety. Many listed servers require authentication and cannot be queried anonymously; that is normal and is not a fault. Absence from the registry is not evidence a server does not exist. Not for: security assessment, recommending which MCP server to install, or checking AI tools in the RightAIChoice catalog (use check_tool_status).

probe.description: Whether to make one anonymous request to a registry-published endpoint to see if it responds.

server.description: The MCP server name or part of it, e.g. "rightaichoice" or "com.example/mcp". Not a URL — only registry-published endpoints are ever contacted.

name: check_mcp_server
title: What the official registry says about an MCP server
